profile.summary: CROP (Creating Restorative Opportunities & Programs) is an Oakland-based nonprofit focused on criminal justice reform and reentry support. It runs leadership development and substance abuse certification programs inside California prisons. Its Ready 4 Life program offers case management, housing assistance and workforce training to people returning from incarceration.

review.notes: ProPublica confirms Crop Organization, Oakland CA, EIN 26-3513635, 501(c)(3); the organization's site expands the name exactly as in the agenda and shows the address, phone, generic info@ email, and the in-prison, certification and Ready 4 Life reentry programs (including case management and supportive housing) described in the neutral summary. No source mentions OUSD directly, but the name, city and workforce/reentry services fit an Adult and Career Education no-cost agreement.
